capabilities: record, pause, and resume voice notes
transcribe and summarize recordings with AI
answer mid-recording questions spoken as 'Hey Scribe'
generate Mermaid charts from the transcript
transcribe existing audio files already in the vault
extras: Transcription and summarization require an internet connection; an OpenAI API key is mandatory (a paid service), while an optional AssemblyAI key earns a $50 credit. Known issue: on iOS the screen must stay on while recording. Includes a 'Fix Mermaid Chart' command for invalid generated charts.
intentEvidence: A special thanks to Drew Mcdonald of the Magic Mic Plugin, this was super useful for learning
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to record voice notes and turn the audio into transcribed, summarized, and structured note content.

relations.evidence: Drew Mcdonald of the Magic Mic Plugin, this was super useful for learning how to access & use the audio buffers
Mossy1022 of the Smart Memos Plugin including Mermaid Charts is SO useful, and I got that idea

summary: Voice recorder that transcribes recordings via AI, summarizes them, answers mid-recording questions, and adds Mermaid charts to the note.
